intro: The alchemist's notebook was written so that only a fellow adept could read it. Every page is a different recipe, and every recipe is a lie with one true ingredient. The laboratory knows the careful fingerprints of its adepts: a thumb steadies the page while the other hand measures verjuice, and the grey smudge left by a fore-finger is part of the witnessing. Certain pages carry the same unsteady smudge in the same margin, as though a line had been corrected by pressure rather than by pen, and the stain never reaches the clean space where the true ingredient waits. The still-fire burns low through the night watches, and the glass stays just warm enough to read by.
echo: One sip and you would live forever, or so the label says.

meta.title: Meta: The Great Work
meta.flavor: Nothing reached the laboratory undamaged. The damage, though, was remarkably consistent.
hints: Did every answer come out clean the first time? Each had exactly one wrong letter. Did you keep them?
